status_reason: This summary records the single canonical real hardware job (D0C7F4...) accepted in issue #55 via the legacy QCloud API. The legacy API path later returned 'Quantum computer under maintenance' (2026-08-21). To continue hardware evidence, the Origin Wukong 180-2 path was migrated to the official QPanda3 Runtime API (RuntimeService / WK_C180_2), which successfully ran three new jobs: Bell (2C68A9D3...), GHZ-3 (B23E5B75...), and Multi (8575222F...). Those new jobs are stored as fully separate evidence packages (originq_runtime_*). This summary does NOT claim additional runs beyond the canonical job; it records the canonical job and points to the separate runtime packages.

summary.stability_note: stability_metric is null because n=1 for the canonical job: a single run cannot produce a meaningful std/min/max. The three runtime reproduction jobs are stored separately and are not averaged into this canonical metric.

traceability_boundary: This is participant-side reproducibility evidence. It does not replace organizer hardware verification. Organizers may log into Origin Quantum Cloud and verify the canonical job D0C7F490B43D9B04FDF19ABF3DB8B342 and the three runtime jobs listed above.
